summary: Recorded the authority-transition question as a witnessed violation bound to experiment 7bf97b230d24477d93e10e441f0cd5c1-experiment (CheckRun e1ee764584564a95b3e288381dfb75d9, exit 0, events 17-18): a node no longer in the configuration sent TimeoutNow and the targeted voter became leader while the healthy leader stepped down, with both comparisons violated; added its behavior entry. The same clean run reproduced the stale-configuration chain at its own events 9, 11 and 12, so that account was re-recorded citing both receipts with joint_history for reproducibility. Remaining work: consolidating the parent configuration question's account so the scan gap and its repair bound are stated together from the three retained receipts.
